status_note: Rebuilt deliverables. Internal proof assessment, not external review. Fresh check counts: structural 135, decoder 98; prior 239-check files are not claimed recovered.

claims.title: Continuous moment-encoder rigidity
claims.claimed_result_or_task: Every continuous exact planar encoder has form c+u*s+v*phi(s), with real-independent u,v; converse exactness also holds.
claims.scope: K>=4; phi continuous on [-1,1], C1 in its interior and nonaffine; psi continuous, interior C1, strictly convex or strictly concave; f=mean(phi)-psi(mean).
claims.criterion: Exact computation; positive squared score implies this prerequisite.
claims.priority_audit: Completion variable, invariance of domain, common local chart for convolution, automatic C1 regularity, global coefficients and nondegeneracy.

claims.title: Exact score of the forced feature curve
claims.scope: phi,psi C1 on the closed interval, each strictly convex or concave; nondegenerate feature curve; global continuous application uses TIT-01.
claims.priority_audit: Check all-pair bound and realizable shrinking configurations approaching endpoint dual-gradient maxima.

claims.title: Exact convex synthesis and planar reconstruction
claims.claimed_result_or_task: Seven real decision variables, PSD conditions and continuous peak inequalities; optimum positive and attained; rank-two reconstruction has no relaxation gap.
claims.scope: Assumptions of TIT-01 and TIT-02; shared planar encoder, pointwise peak P.
claims.priority_audit: Check PSD reduction, distinct endpoint slopes, compactness and every peak constraint. This is not a generic closed-form optimizer.

claims.title: Explicit quadratic-feature optimum
claims.claimed_result_or_task: Optimal parabola with b determined by M=abs(psi_prime(1)); variance score 4*K^2*P/(9+6*sqrt(3)).
claims.scope: K>=4; phi(s)=s^2; psi even, C1, strictly convex or concave; nontrivial target.
claims.priority_audit: Verify normalization, peak boundary reduction, parameter ranges and global versus family-only K=2,3 scope.

claims.title: Explicit quartic-feature optimum
claims.claimed_result_or_task: An algebraically specified quartic curve has an analytic peak factorization and a global optimality certificate; fourth-order Jensen gap score approximately 0.058533506998*K^2*P.
claims.scope: K>=4; phi(s)=s^4; psi even, C1, strictly convex or concave.
claims.priority_audit: Check root range/uniqueness, signs, feasible contacts, KKT certificate and target naming.

claims.title: Admissible moment-polynomial targets
claims.claimed_result_or_task: Arbitrary-degree polynomials F(m,q) under coefficient/parity restrictions admit an explicit optimal parabola determined by endpoint partial derivatives.
claims.scope: K>=4; nonnegative coefficients; common parity of mean exponents; positive endpoint partial derivatives in both variables.
claims.priority_audit: The application uses the continuous two-moment lemma; audit polynomial completion, pure-q highest term, monotonicity, exact score and parameter optimum.

claims.title: Local-quadratic metric transfer
claims.claimed_result_or_task: For the stated target class, D(d)>=c_D*d^2 and D(d)/d^2 -> c_D>0 imply the same optimizer and Lambda_D=c_D*Lambda_sq.
claims.scope: Requires the exact local score and realizable shrinking active pairs; use the original target assumptions.
claims.criterion: Specified local-quadratic radial criteria, including centered exponential under its hypotheses.
claims.priority_audit: Do not apply to uncentered exp(a*d^2); check equality rather than only one inequality.

claims.title: General-radial quadratic family reduction
claims.claimed_result_or_task: Optimization over exact encoders reduces to a one-parameter parabolic family; extending the smooth competitor class uses continuous rigidity.
claims.scope: K>=4; nontrivial symmetric quadratic; finite continuous nondecreasing radial D positive away from zero, with inherited exactness and transform conditions.
claims.criterion: Specified general radial criteria; equality of suprema need not imply attainment.
claims.priority_audit: Check the b->2 boundary, exactness requirement when D(0)>0, and what remains unsolved about the best parameter.

claims.title: Uniform disturbance-amplification interpretation
claims.claimed_result_or_task: Best uniform amplification for one scalar decoder equals Lambda_sq^(-1/2); fixed-radius recovery is a separate objective.
claims.scope: Continuous scalar target, exact encoder with finite inverse Lipschitz constant; all inputs and additive disturbances.
claims.criterion: Uniform absolute-error amplification, not unrestricted Gaussian MSE.
claims.priority_audit: Credit classical extension/recovery arguments; check off-image decoder and avoid transferring fixed-radius optimality.

claims.title: Coherence geometry and stability reference
claims.claimed_result_or_task: Legacy source claims all-K/all-J coherence optimum and equality classification with sharp dimension-dependent stability exponents.
claims.scope: K>=2, C^J output with total peak block energy; fixed common pi-length source phase window and calibration.
claims.criterion: Squared separation for the specific coherence target.
claims.priority_audit: Do not treat this source as the new paper outline or the intended broad function class.

claims.title: Practical decoder with a certified bound
claims.claimed_result_or_task: Develop and verify a computable projection-and-readout decoder for selected moment curves.
claims.scope: Nondegenerate feature encoder with C1 closed-interval strictly convex/concave generators. Closed-form received-strip metric projection; polynomial rectangle extension under stated restrictions.
claims.criterion: Uniform amplification; separate empirical Gaussian MSE where measured.
claims.priority_audit: This is a proposed work item, not a completed new theorem or numerical result.

claims.title: Finite-alphabet distinction
claims.claimed_result_or_task: For K=4 binary variance, antipodal peak signaling gives 64*P/9, above the restriction of the continuum variance-optimal parabola.
claims.scope: Inputs {-1,1}; K=4; same pointwise peak constraint; empirical variance normalization.
claims.priority_audit: Recompute finite pairs and keep the result distinct from Gaussian finite-witness inheritance.
